correctness.rationale: For algebraically closed k with characteristic not 2, the eight magic-sum equalities give rank six: the claimed integer six-by-six minor is a unit and the nine Lucas forms w+a*u+b*v span the 3-dimensional kernel. Pullback by the finite-flat coordinatewise squaring map is a complete intersection of six quadrics of degree 64, generically integral since valuations at eight distinct branch lines make their Kummer classes independent. An independent exact determinant enumeration of all 84 triples of the 3x3 coefficient grid recovered exactly eight collinear triples in characteristic 0 or p>=5 and twelve in p=3; max absolute determinant four. Double branch crossings are smooth; triple crossings have nondegenerate local equation r^2=alpha*s^2+beta*t^2 and each has 32 geometric preimages, producing 256 versus 384 A1 nodes. Normality follows from S2 and R1. AGL2(F3) has 432 elements, permutes nine affine labels and is transitive on twelve triples; combined with 256 sign changes gives faithful order-110592 node-transitive subgroup. This is not a full char-3 automorphism classification; char2 excluded. Finite incidence checks support but do not prove generic integrality/local algebraic geometry.
